entities.summary: Johan Carl Kempe was the leader of the Swedish pulp and paper industry Mo och Domsjö AB and was involved in several other companies in the large economic sphere of the Kempe family. He was also a silver medalist in tennis at the 1912 Summer Olympics in Stockholm.
